title: The Third Inheritance
author: Silas Sterling
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
